title: Large shell output dumps can become circular and unrecoverable
wanted_capability: When shell output exceeds inline limits, the harness should preserve a bounded diagnostic tail and exit status without requiring agents to chase dump files that reference other dumps.
missing_primitive: Robust shell output capture/dump tail for large compile output
fallback_used: Use blocking shell mode with a bounded output cap. For very noisy Gradle output, recipe now allows an exit-preserving filtered command via `bash -o pipefail` and a non-short-circuiting filter; host-side verification still reruns the unfiltered gate when needed.
notes: Genericized from private Java refactor probes. Probe 4 confirmed the tension: the bare compile preserved exit status but dumped large generated-code noise; the agent then used a piped/head command to reduce output, violating protocol. Recipe was updated to allow only exit-preserving filters and prohibit head/tail short-circuit filters. Underlying missing primitive remains a shell_run post-capture filter/summary that preserves the primary command exit status without shell-pipe discipline.
